subject: Mutual Action Plan + Evaluation -> Commit timeline (Solaris AI)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@solaris.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan proposal and evaluation timeline

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the great conversation yesterday. As discussed, I sketched a proposal for a short evaluation that leads into a committed production rollout. Attached is a one-page MAP draft (Solaris_MAP_v1.xlsx) that ties milestones to commercial events so both teams have clear checkpoints. High level: 

- Week 1–2: POC kickoff, integration checklist, sample prompts and eval set
- Week 3–6: Scoped QA and performance/eval metrics (latency, cost per 1k tokens, quality gates)
- Week 7: E2E demo and mutual signoff on acceptance criteria
- Month 2–3: Ramp to reserved capacity; commit levels and discounted pricing tiers activate on signed commitment

Proposed pricing highlights (draft):
- POC: $0 (pilot credits) + pay-as-you-go hosted tokens for non-sensitive traffic
- Commit tier A: 100k tokens/day -> 15% discount off list
- Commit tier B: 300k tokens/day -> 25% discount off list

If you can confirm a POC start week (we can start as early as 4/6), I’ll update the MAP with exact dates and share a DocuSign to lock the initial commitment terms. Goal: get to a signed MAP and commitment by 2026-04-15 so we can secure reserved capacity and the quoted uplift pricing for renewal.

Attaching the MAP v1 for your review.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Solaris_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@solaris.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan proposal and evaluation timeline

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the tidy breakdown. Quick clarifying questions: 

1) Can you tie the discount tiers to clear ramp milestones (e.g., sustained throughput for 30 days) rather than instantaneous spikes?
2) For renewal/expansion — will you entertain a renewal uplift discount if we hit 3x the initial commit within 12 months? That will be a key ask from procurement.
3) Can you provide a rough estimate of the reserved capacity lead time and how long you can hold quoted pricing once the MAP is signed?

We’re targeting a POC start the week of 4/13 to align with internal availability; procurement will want a mutual action plan and a short checklist to attach to the contracting folder. I’ll loop them in on the next email.

Best,
Sophie Lang
Head of Product, Solaris AI
Sophie.Lang@solaris.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-04T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan proposal and evaluation timeline

Sophie —

Great questions; I updated the MAP and attached a version that contains explicit measurable milestones. Key updates in Solaris_MAP_v1.xlsx: 

- Discounts tied to sustained throughput: each tier requires 30 consecutive days at threshold (e.g., Tier A = 100k/day sustained for 30 days).
- Renewal uplift: we can offer a conditional renewal uplift (3% additional discount at renewal) if you reach 3x commit within 12 months AND maintain quality gates (per evaluation checklist).
- Reserved capacity: lead time is 3–4 weeks for Dedicated pools; we can hold quoted pricing for 21 days from signed MAP subject to inventory.

I also sketched an initial mutual acceptance criteria appendix (sample eval prompts + pass/fail thresholds) so procurement has a checklist to attach. If POC start is 4/13, milestone schedule would look like: 

- 4/13: POC kickoff (integration tasks + sample data exchange)
- 4/20: mid-POC health check (model perf + latency report)
- 5/04: acceptance demo + signoff
- 5/10: commit signature -> reserved capacity provisioning (3 weeks)

Can we aim for a signed MAP by 4/15 to hold pricing? If procurement needs more time, we can extend to 4/22 but pricing hold drops by 75% after that.

Next step: I’ll send a clean MAP + DocuSign link for signature if this aligns.

Thanks,
Marcus

Attachments: Solaris_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated with milestones)
From: Procurement Team <procure@solaris.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@solaris.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-06T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan proposal and evaluation timeline

Marcus / Monica —

Procurement here. A few items we need clarified before routing to legal: 

- Confirm the renewal uplift mechanism: Sophie referenced a conditional 3% additional discount at renewal if Solaris achieves 3x the initial commit within 12 months. We need the exact formula and any caps (e.g., max total discount cannot exceed 35%).
- Please provide an SLA exception policy for burst traffic during ramp (we sometimes have short spikes during experimentation).
- We prefer the 30-day sustained measurement window to be measured on a rolling basis rather than calendar months. Is that acceptable?

Also, include a single-sheet summary for our contracts folder (one-slide MAP summary). Once those items are in the MAP we can route to legal and return redlines within 5 business days.

Procurement
Solaris AI
procure@solaris.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procure@solaris.ai>, Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@solaris.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-07T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan proposal and evaluation timeline — updates and DocuSign

Procurement / Sophie —

Thanks for the clear list. I’ve incorporated the procurement asks into Solaris_MAP_v2.xlsx (attached) and pulled a one-page MAP summary for the contracts folder. Summary of updates: 

- Renewal uplift mechanics: If Solaris reaches >=3x the baseline committed daily throughput (baseline defined as committed tier at signing) sustained for any rolling 30-day window within 12 months, Redwood will apply a one-time 3% additional discount on the first renewal term. This uplift is additive but capped so that total effective discount will not exceed 35% off list price.
- Measurement: rolling 30-day sustained window computed from token consumption metrics; we will provide dashboards and monthly reports.
- SLA exceptions: we will include a burst policy allowing short-duration throughput increases; material sustained overage will be handled per overage policy in the MAP.
- Pricing hold: we can commit to holding pricing for 21 days post-signature; if signature is after 2026-04-22 the uplift guarantees revert to referential pricing and require re-approval.

Next steps: 
1) I uploaded Solaris_MAP_v2.xlsx to the HubSpot deal and created a DocuSign envelope (link below) with the signature-ready acceptance + commitment page.
2) If procurement is happy, routing to legal with the one-page summary should keep turnaround within 5 business days.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/contract/3fa2b4d7
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/83421

If you confirm POC start 4/13 and procurement confirms the measurement language, I’ll send the DocuSign and change the MAP version on the drive.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: Solaris_MAP_v2.xlsx (PROD-ready MAP + summary)
